tools.title: Amplitude

servers.name: Amplitude MCP Server
servers.capabilities: Query analytics; read and create charts, dashboards, notebooks, experiments, cohorts, feature flags and metrics; manage taxonomy.

tools.notes: Included in Enterprise, add-on on Plus, not on Free or Growth. EU data uses https://mcp.eu.amplitude.com/mcp; writes need the 'Use MCP (write)' permission.

tools.title: Google Analytics

servers.name: Google Analytics MCP Server
servers.capabilities: Run reports and realtime reports, inspect account and property configuration; write tools only with --allow-write.
servers.scopes: https://www.googleapis.com/auth/analytics.readonly. Consent: Set up Google Application Default Credentials and grant access to the intended Analytics properties.

read_only.how: Every tool reads unless the server starts with --allow-write, which the registered command does not pass; it asks only the analytics.readonly scope.

tools.notes: Read-only by default; uses Application Default Credentials with the analytics.readonly scope.

tools.title: Matomo

servers.name: Matomo MCP Server plugin

settings.name: matomo_host
settings.description: Matomo: your matomo host, without https://

servers.capabilities: Read-oriented analytics reporting; optional segment writes and raw API access when an administrator enables them.
servers.access: Read or write, depending on the server configuration, the tools enabled or the consent given.

tools.notes: Disabled by default: a superuser enables it under Administration > System > General Settings > McpServer. Included in Matomo Cloud; on-premise installs need the McpServer plugin (and the OAuth 2.0 plugin for OAuth), otherwise token_auth as a Bearer token.

tools.title: Mixpanel

servers.name: Mixpanel MCP server
servers.capabilities: Run queries, read reports and dashboards, manage dashboards, events and properties, cohorts, metrics, experiments and feature flags; all writes are audit-logged.

tools.notes: EU: https://mcp-eu.mixpanel.com/mcp, India: https://mcp-in.mixpanel.com/mcp. Orgs created before 1 Aug 2026 need an admin to enable MCP; service-account auth is beta.

tools.title: Plausible

servers.name: plausible-mcp (by Sentry)
servers.capabilities: Query Plausible stats through the Stats API.
servers.access: Read operations described; no enforced read-only mode is recorded.

tools.notes: No official Plausible server found on 2026-11-21; Plausible's docs list this community server built by Sentry (Stats API key as Bearer header, or local stdio with PLAUSIBLE_API_KEY). Small project, tagged non-production.

tools.title: PostHog
tools.summary: Product analytics, feature flags, experiments and session replay.

servers.name: PostHog MCP server
servers.capabilities: Read and write across PostHog: analytics queries, HogQL, feature flags, experiments, error tracking, CDP destinations, docs search.

tools.notes: One endpoint routes to the US or EU region from the signed-in account; personal API keys use the MCP Server preset. Rate limit 480 requests per minute.
